unit.why: This is the closing of an author's preface or colophon: a prayer that the merit of the ten tsaddikim protect him, then a humble signature by Yisrael son of R. Yitzhak Simha. There is no narrative.
unit.boundary_note: Fragment of a closing formula; it begins mid-sentence ('חלו תליתאי...'), continuing the preceding enumeration of the book's sections.
